saw_lines: Bakers buy a mould for one recipe, then reuse it only if the first bake releases cleanly.
So the sale is won in the first seconds of the video, when a baker decides the bake looks worth trying.
Your 30 live ads show no proof number, so collect one review count or orders shipped figure and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: None of the 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer has nothing to trust before the click. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.

Six of your 24 copy ads open on the same “un job qui s’adapte vraiment” line, so a new buyer sees one pitch across the account. Test two new openers against it: one on the cooking result, one on the first bake.
None of your 24 copy ads carries an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put one clear first order offer or a bundle of the OHRA moulds in the opening line of the new videos.

20 ads have run 60+ days, starting with the OHRA mould video from April 2024. A repeat viewer gets the same pitch, so build three more variations of that video, changing the opening shot and first line.

ads_1: Mould videos opening on the finished bake, tested against the job line
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Tiktok, Twitter and Youtube
